# Lawsons

> > Lawsons is an independent timber and building materials merchant specializing in fencing supplies, garden products, and B2B commerce for the London and South East regions.

Lawsons (Whetstone) Ltd operates as a timber merchant and builders merchant with a heritage dating back to 1921. The site provides both retail and B2B functionality, including product catalogs, quote requests, account management, and store locator services across multiple locations.

## Fencing Products

- [Fencing Supplies](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies): Fencing supplies category: panels, posts, gravel boards for London and South East
- [Fence Panels](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/fence-panels): Fence panels product page: closeboard, lap, and trellis designs
- [Closeboard Fence Panels](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/fence-panels/closeboard-fence-panels): Closeboard fence panels: UK-made timber for privacy and boundary screening
- [Lap Fence Panels](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/fence-panels/lap-fence-panels): Pressure-treated lap fence panels including Herts Lap variant
- [Decorative Fence Panels](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/fence-panels/decorative-fence-panels): Decorative and contemporary slatted fence panels from Jacksons Fencing
- [Trellis Panels](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/fence-panels/trellis-panels): Trellis panels for privacy lattice and climbing plant support
- [Picket Fence Panels](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/fence-panels/open-pale-picket-fence-panels): UK-manufactured picket fence panels for garden boundaries
- [Closeboard Fencing](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/fencing-supplies/closeboard-fencing): Closeboard fencing materials: featheredge boards, rails, and capping

## Customer Accounts & Shopping

- [Homepage](https://www.lawsons.co.uk): Lawsons homepage: timber, fencing, and builders merchants with product catalog
- [Login or Register](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/customer/account/logout): Customer authentication and account management portal
- [Customer Account](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/customer/account): Customer account creation and B2B company account management
- [Wishlist](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/wishlist): Customer wishlist and saved items feature for online shopping
- [Advanced Search](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/catalogsearch/advanced): Advanced product search with filters for sheds, summerhouses, and playhouses
- [B2B Quote Request](https://www.lawsons.co.uk/negotiable_quote/quote): B2B quote request and account type selection (cash/credit/drawdown)
